name_en: Tsugani Jiru — a soup pounded whole from a live river crab, shell and all
summary_ja: 四万十川などに棲むモクズガニ「ツガニ」を生きたまま甲羅ごと粉砕し、その出汁でなすやりゅうきゅうを煮る高知の秋の汁物。産卵で川を下る秋が旬とされ、資源保護のため禁漁期間が設けられている。
summary_en: A live mitten crab called tsugani, caught in rivers like the Shimanto, is pounded whole, shell included, and the resulting stock is used to simmer eggplant and taro-leaf stalk — an autumn soup in Kochi. The crab is said to be at its best in autumn as it heads downstream to spawn, and a closed season now protects the stock.
source_title: つがに汁 高知県 | うちの郷土料理：農林水産省
